propositions: Detached pytest runs via nohup report errors that do not reproduce in foreground runs, masking the real cause: concurrent external mutation of the shared checkout.
The _no_repo_root_leaks autouse guard misattributes external top-level file writes to innocent tests and silently deletes those files, preventing detection of concurrent mutations.
Browser e2e test failures on signal-killed children report empty stderr without consulting proc.returncode, producing indistinguishable diagnostics from genuine product failures.
Detached runs are structurally the only mode enabling concurrent external mutation because foreground runs block the agent; detachment is an enabler, not the root cause.

Guard messages must honestly name the possibility of external concurrent processes rather than asserting tests caused mutations they may not have created, and diagnostics must distinguish signal kills from genuine failures.
